lessons.briefing: In professional workshop practice, mastering Computer Hardware: Motherboard Components, CPU, RAM, Storage Devices, PSU, Peripheral Interfaces and Fault Finding requires strict adherence to safety standards and sequential execution. Always inspect personal protective equipment (PPE), ensure proper tool calibration, and verify that the workpiece is securely mounted before commencing. Observe manufacturer specifications and relevant standards. Maintain a clean work environment, store consumables dry, and double-check your alignment.
